nodes.title: HAProxy CVE-2026-33555 H3->H1 desync via standalone QUIC FIN
nodes.summary: Standalone QUIC FIN drives H3->H1 request desync in HAProxy (USE_QUIC=1); reportedly found by an LLM (Claude Code Opus 4.6) reading an ~8k-line mux. Pillar: H3 frontend to H1 backend translation.
nodes.specifics: Blog 2026-04-17. Invariant: stream FIN/length consistency checked before downgrade to H1 framing.

nodes.title: CDN Tsunami: H3->H1.1 conversion amplification (HBA/HCA)
nodes.summary: arXiv 2607.26589 (blog 2026-08-20). HBA: QPACK expansion up to 350x at Alibaba/Baidu/Tencent CDNs, 36-66x others; HCA: backend connection per HEADERS, all but Cloudflare (buffers). <500Kbps in -> >100Mbps to origin. No CVE.
nodes.specifics: Invariant: decoded-header-bytes budget per stream pre-translation; do not open backend conn until request complete.
nodes.overclaim_risk: secondary summary; PDF not fully verified

nodes.title: Cross-client QPACK dynamic table leakage on reused backend QUIC conn
nodes.summary: Dartmouth senior thesis 2026-06-05 (J. Parfrey): shared QPACK table across clients on pooled backend H3 conn gives RTT timing side channel.
nodes.specifics: Rule: no cross-tenant sharing of QPACK dynamic table / backend conn.
nodes.underclaim_risk: real design constraint for pooled upstream

nodes.title: quicly (H2O) CVE-2026-44436 connection state corruption DoS
nodes.summary: quicly conn state corruption; fix commit 8b178e6.

nodes.title: Opossum Attack (USENIX Sec 2026): opportunistic TLS desync
nodes.summary: Implicit+opportunistic TLS coexistence breaks auth via MitM; HTTP RFC 2817 Upgrade: TLS/1.0 has 4 exploit directions; >3M servers support both; 20,121 HTTP servers opportunistic; 539 same-domain exploitable; Apache 2.4.62 PoC; Apache removed RFC2817.
nodes.specifics: Invariant: never implement Upgrade: TLS (RFC 2817)/STARTTLS; one TLS mode per port; test: reject Upgrade: TLS header.

nodes.title: NDSS26 MerCuriuzz: logical vulns in QUIC implementations
nodes.summary: Black-box fuzzing 16 impls, 14 new logic vulns (quiche, xquic, aioquic named), 6 categories, 11 vendor-confirmed. Companion draft-chen-quic-logical-vuln-mitigations-00 (2026-03-13).
nodes.specifics: Use the draft's categories as QUIC state-machine test checklist.
nodes.overclaim_risk: vulns in other impls, not necessarily Rust pins

nodes.title: x402 payment attack literature (3 papers)
nodes.summary: arXiv 2607.19545 'When HTTP 402 Meets the Blockchain': 8 facilitator rules, 4 attacks (Free Shopping, Asset Theft, Service Denial, Gas Abuse), 15 facilitators tested, 119M tx measured; arXiv 2605.11781 Five Attacks on x402; arXiv 2605.30998 Free-Riding the Agentic Web.
nodes.specifics: Attack side of 402: binding, replay, gas abuse.

nodes.title: NDSS26 Token Time Bomb: JWT implementation vulns
nodes.summary: 43 JWT impls/10 languages, 31 new vulns, 20 CVEs, k8s auth bypass; JWTeemo/JWTFuzz.
nodes.specifics: Run JWTFuzz against any JWT/capability verifier; prefer non-JWT capability tokens.

nodes.title: NDSS26 Looma: low-latency PQ-TLS auth
nodes.summary: On/off-path precompute, one-time sig over transcript; -44% handshake latency vs Dilithium2; draft-ma-cfrg-looma-00 (Mar 2026).
nodes.specifics: Research-stage; not a deployable pin.
nodes.underclaim_risk: ML-DSA handshake cost is attackable by design

nodes.title: Time for ACKrobatics (BH USA26) / Time and Time Again (NDSS26)
nodes.summary: TCP timestamps reveal server processing time: jitter-immune remote timing attacks, several x more efficient than RTT; any TCP protocol; disabling ts breaks RTTM/PAWS.
nodes.specifics: Constant-time claims must hold at TCP-timestamp resolution; timing harness using the ts side channel.
nodes.overclaim_risk: resolution limited by OS ts granularity
nodes.underclaim_risk: undermines network-noise argument for non-constant-time code

nodes.title: DEF CON 34 Krasnov: PQC impl attack vectors
nodes.summary: Parser memory corruption at key_share deserialization, compiler-induced timing (Clangover CVE-2024-37880, Clang 15-18), ML-DSA ExpandMask loop-abort fault; hybrid does not help vs parser RCE.
nodes.specifics: CI gate: dudect/ctgrind on ML-KEM decaps with pinned compiler; fuzz key_share parser.
nodes.overclaim_risk: slides only; URL is media root

nodes.title: LiteLLM CVE-2026-59822 MCP auth bypass (fail-open to empty principal), in CISA KEV
nodes.summary: CVE-2026-59821 guardrail sandbox RCE; CVE-2026-59822 MCP auth bypass: failed key check replaced by an empty UserAPIKeyAuth() via OAuth2 passthrough fallback (fixed 1.84.0), added to CISA KEV 2026-09-02 with active exploitation; second bypass via substring public-route match; default key sk-1234.
nodes.specifics: Invariant: auth errors never map to default-principal; Principal cannot be default-constructed.
nodes.overclaim_risk: DEF CON slide source replaced by CVE records

nodes.title: DEF CON 34: WAF 403 logs / Sentry DSN as prompt-injection channels
nodes.summary: WAF block logs, public Sentry DSN, Datadog tokens inject into debugging agents; claimed 90% success vs a coding agent editing DNS; ~15k orgs; desktop-agent egress JWT reuse escape (patched, no CVE).
nodes.specifics: Server error/log text containing attacker bytes is untrusted agent input; escape in logs.
nodes.underclaim_risk: server logs as attack surface for agent operators

nodes.title: Apache APISIX 26 CVE-2026 advisories (auth plugin logic)
nodes.summary: jwt-auth CVE-2026-39999 alg confusion, jwe-decrypt CVE-2026-49230, hmac-auth replay 47341, cas-auth x5, opa 49231 identity spoof, openid-connect x4, forward-auth x2, route/upstream authz mismatch from servlet-style path normalization CVE-2026-94269 (fixed 3.19.0).
nodes.specifics: Plugin-per-auth-scheme multiplies logic bugs; supports single auth path.
nodes.overclaim_risk: count as of 2026-10-24; AI-driven discovery inflates

nodes.title: nginx CVE-2026-42055 proxy_v2/grpc module
nodes.summary: ngx_http_proxy_v2_module + grpc; companion to CVE-2026-42530 (June 2026, 1.31.0-1.31.1).

nodes.title: SOSP26 Lion: modular verification of async runtime liveness
nodes.summary: Tokio-compatible Rust runtime with Verus-verified liveness contract, >=95% of unverified throughput on 9 workloads, evaluated with rumqtt, Pingora, Axum. Related UBC Jackdaw.
nodes.specifics: PDF not fetched (ACM 403). Candidate for runtime-liveness gate.
nodes.underclaim_risk: first Verus liveness contract for a Tokio-API runtime

nodes.title: OSDI26 Ote: extracting DB access-control policies from web apps
nodes.summary: Concolic execution of Rails apps to SQL view policies; found errors in handwritten policies.
nodes.specifics: Peripheral; also OSDI26 Aletheia, Rakaia kTLS RPC.

nodes.title: Korean KpqC winners and Japanese NCO PQC timeline (non-English gov sources)
nodes.summary: KpqC: NTRU+, SMAUG-T (KEM), HAETAE, AIMer (sig). eprint 2026/2342 Rust KpqC provider with rustls TLS1.3 group; SMAUG-T 1280/1344 B vs ML-KEM-768 2272 B; eprint 2025/1245 KpqC certs 11.5-48x ECC; NTRU+ CFRG I-D (June 2026). Japan NCO interim report Nov 2025: gov PQC by 2035, hybrid + crypto-agility.
nodes.specifics: Keep KEM group pluggable for Korean gov market.

nodes.title: 5G core SBI (HTTP/2) 2026 advisory cluster: NRF as confused-deputy hub
nodes.summary: Open5GS CVE-2026-8746 (NRF discovery UAF), 8744, 14618, 82589; free5GC CVE-2026-33062, CVE-2026-55068 (NF registration endpoint poisoning), GHSA-f8qv-7x5w-qr48 (/oauth2/token type confusion). Drishti arXiv 2608.30112; FivGeeFuzz arXiv 2509.08992.
nodes.specifics: Registry/discovery poisoning analogous to MCP registry/agent card.

nodes.title: Cloudflare 2025-11-18 outage: oversized generated config -> Rust unwrap panic
nodes.summary: ClickHouse permission change duplicated rows; Bot Mgmt feature file 2x; limit 200 vs ~60 used; FL2 Rust proxy unwrap() panic -> 5xx; core restored 14:30 UTC, all 17:06.
nodes.specifics: Gate: clippy unwrap_used/expect_used deny in proxy core; generated config validated, limit exceed fails soft to last-known-good; global kill switch.

nodes.title: Device Bound Session Credentials (W3C ED 2026-09-08)
nodes.summary: Server exposes registration + refresh endpoints; Secure-Session-Registration/-Challenge/-Response/-Skipped, Sec-Secure-Session-Id; proof JWT typ dbsc+jwt RS256/ES256/none; no PQ signature in spec.
nodes.specifics: Session primitive vs cookie theft; PQ gap; reject alg none.

nodes.title: CERT/CC VU#885548 / JVN JVNVU90338324: HTTP/2 stalled flow-control DoS
nodes.summary: SETTINGS_INITIAL_WINDOW_SIZE=0 or withheld WINDOW_UPDATE makes server buffer response bodies; CVE-2026-44909, 59173, 59762; ATS fixed 9.2.14/10.1.3, NetScaler timeout default 0; not affected Cloudflare, Fastly, GitHub, HAProxy, Go, gRPC, nghttp2; 118 vendors, most no statement.
nodes.specifics: Per-stream outbound buffer cap, stall timer, no body generation ahead of window; JVN source 2026-07-22. Harness: client sets window 0 and measures RSS.
nodes.underclaim_risk: direct test case for hyper/h2 pins

nodes.title: runwasi CVE-2026-47218: untrusted precompiled Wasmtime bytes deserialized as native code
nodes.summary: containerd-shim-wasmtime <0.6.1 treated precompiled bytes in an OCI layer as trusted cache, skipping Wasm validation (CWE-502, CVSS4 9.3, 2026-10-15); fix 0.6.1.
nodes.specifics: Rule: never Module::deserialize untrusted bytes; precompile cache keyed and MACed locally; test: feed precompiled artifact, expect reject.
nodes.underclaim_risk: wasm-host class distinct from wasmtime GHSA record
